description: A button for destructive actions that asks for a second click: the first click arms it, the second confirms, and it disarms after a few seconds, on blur or on Escape.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.description: The button's text before it's armed.

inputs.name: ConfirmLabel
inputs.description: The button's text while it's armed, also announced to screen readers.

inputs.name: TimeoutSeconds
inputs.description: How long it stays armed before going back to Label. 0 or less uses 4.

inputs.name: IsDisabled
inputs.description: Disables the button, and disarms it.

events.name: OnConfirmed
events.description: Raised on the second click, while armed. Do the destructive action here.

modifiers.description: The button fills its container's width, as on phones.
